blocks.text:
STAGE 4Action engine
What happensConverts extracted fields into a checklist: what to do (pay, reply, visit, submit), the deadline and consequence, documents to carry, and where to go. Ranks items by urgency. Rule-based checks run alongside the LLM, for example marking a past deadline as overdue.
Tech usedSarvam chat model for reasoning, deterministic rules in code for dates and priorities.
OutputOrdered checklist with urgency labels.

STAGE 5Plain-language explanation
What happensRewrites the content at a simple reading level in the user's language. Official terms are kept with a short meaning next to them so the user can still use them at the office.
Tech usedSarvam chat model, Sarvam translation and transliteration for script handling.
OutputShort explanation and checklist in the chosen language.

STAGE 6Voice layer
What happensThe user asks follow-ups by voice, for example "Can I pay this online?" or "What happens if I am late?". The answer is generated only from the document content, with a clear "not mentioned in this document" fallback, and is spoken back.
Tech usedSaaras (speech-to-text), Sarvam chat model with document-grounded prompting, Bulbul (text-to-speech).
OutputSpoken and written answer in the user's language.

STAGE 7Output and handoff
What happensShows a card-style summary: document type, deadline, steps, documents. The user can share it as a WhatsApp-ready message or PDF with a family member. Optional deadline reminders. Documents are deleted after the session.
Tech usedFrontend rendering, PDF export, share links.
OutputSummary card, shareable file, optional reminder.
